knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

# Load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(haven)
library(conflicted)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(openxlsx)

# **Overview**

Checking the quality of SNPs used and visualizing T1GRS in TEDDY_matprot


# **Load Data** 

```{r, message = F}

# SNPs info
vcf_table <- read.table("Maternal_Protection/data/teddy/genetics/risk_scores/t1grs/step1_t1grs_id_fix.vcf",
                        header = FALSE, 
                        comment.char = "#", 
                        sep = "\t")

# score file (T1GRS) which we calculated
prs_scores <- read.csv("Maternal_Protection/data/teddy/genetics/risk_scores/t1grs/T1GRS_probabilities_r3.csv ")


# Phenotype raw file
pheno_raw<- read.csv("Maternal_Protection/raw/TEDDYarrays_v2/additional_data/Norris_demographic_masked.csv")

#GRS2x file with imputation
GRS2x_imputed<- read.csv("Maternal_Protection/data/teddy/genetics/risk_scores/grs2x/tm_r3_imp/score_results_imputed.csv")

# GRS2_1000G and AA_PRS 
grs2 <- read.csv("Maternal_Protection/data/teddy/famhist_prs/archive/teddy_t1d_genetic_risk_scores.csv")

```

# **Quality Check**



```{r}
vcf_selected_col <- vcf_table %>%
  select(V1, V2, V3, V4, V5, V7, V8) %>%
  rename(CHR = V1, POS = V2, Cluster = V3, REF = V4,
         ALT = V5, FILTER = V7, INFO = V8)



```

```{r}
# Extract MAF and R2 from INFO column using regular expressions

SNP_quality_check <- vcf_selected_col %>%
  mutate(
    MAF_value = as.numeric(str_extract(INFO, "(?<=MAF=)[0-9.]+(?=;)")),
    R2_value  = as.numeric(str_extract(INFO, "(?<=R2=)[0-9.]+(?=;|$)"))
  )
# View summary stats
summary(SNP_quality_check$MAF_value)
summary(SNP_quality_check$R2_value)

# Or get exact min and max
min_MAF <- min(SNP_quality_check$MAF_value, na.rm = TRUE)
max_MAF <- max(SNP_quality_check$MAF_value, na.rm = TRUE)

min_R2 <- min(SNP_quality_check$R2_value, na.rm = TRUE)
max_R2 <- max(SNP_quality_check$R2_value, na.rm = TRUE)

cat("MAF range:", min_MAF, "to", max_MAF, "\n")
cat("R2  range:", min_R2, "to", max_R2, "\n")
```

### Table: SNPs - MAF
```{r}
#  All SNPs with their CHR, POS, Cluster, and MAF
MAF_table_all <- SNP_quality_check %>%
  select(CHR, POS, Cluster,FILTER, MAF_value) %>%
  arrange(MAF_value)

# Table 1: Top 10 SNPs with lowest MAF
MAF_table_lowest10 <- MAF_table_all %>%
  slice_min(MAF_value, n = 10)

# Print top 10 lowest MAF SNPs
cat("\nTop 10 SNPs with lowest MAF:\n")
print(MAF_table_lowest10)

# Table 2: SNPs that passed filters
MAF_table_pass <- SNP_quality_check %>%
  dplyr::filter(FILTER == "PASS") %>%
  select(CHR, POS, Cluster, FILTER, MAF_value) %>%
  arrange(MAF_value)

# Print table with SNPs that passed filters
cat("\nSNPs that passed filter (PASS):\n")
print(MAF_table_pass)


```

### Table: SNPs - R2

```{r}

# All SNPs with their CHR, POS, Cluster, and R2
R2_table_all <- SNP_quality_check %>%
  select(CHR, POS, Cluster, FILTER, R2_value) %>%
  arrange(R2_value)

# Table 3: Top 10 SNPs with lowest R2
R2_table_lowest10 <- R2_table_all %>%
  slice_min(R2_value, n = 10)

cat("\nTop 10 SNPs with lowest R2:\n")
print(R2_table_lowest10)

# Table 4: SNPs that passed filters
R2_table_pass <- SNP_quality_check %>%
  dplyr::filter(FILTER == "PASS") %>%
  select(CHR, POS, Cluster, FILTER, R2_value) %>%
  arrange(R2_value)

cat("\nSNPs that passed filter (PASS) - R2:\n")
print(R2_table_pass)


```

### To see how many are TYPED and IMPUTED SNPs are present
```{r}


# Detect "TYPED" and "IMPUTED" in INFO column
SNP_quality_check$Typed <- grepl("TYPED", SNP_quality_check$INFO)
SNP_quality_check$Imputed <- grepl("IMPUTED", SNP_quality_check$INFO)

# Create a new column for SNP category
SNP_quality_check$SNP_Category <- with(SNP_quality_check, 
  ifelse(Typed & Imputed, "Typed and Imputed",
  ifelse(Typed & !Imputed, "Typed only",
  ifelse(!Typed & Imputed, "Imputed only", "Other"))))

# View summary table with relevant columns
summary_SNP_quality_check <- SNP_quality_check[, c("CHR", "POS", "Cluster", "INFO", "SNP_Category")]

# Print first few rows to check
head(summary_SNP_quality_check)

# Print counts for each category
cat("Number of Typed only SNPs:", sum(SNP_quality_check$SNP_Category == "Typed only"), "\n")
cat("Number of Imputed only SNPs:", sum(SNP_quality_check$SNP_Category == "Imputed only"), "\n")
cat("Number of Typed and Imputed SNPs:", sum(SNP_quality_check$SNP_Category == "Typed and Imputed"), "\n")

```





### Phenotype file

```{r}

#Subset phenotype file to IDs and t1d status
pheno<- pheno_raw %>%
  select(ID= Norris_epigenetics_maskid, t1d)
  
pheno$ID <- as.character(pheno$ID)

# Label t1d group
pheno <- pheno %>%
  mutate(t1d= ifelse(t1d == 0, "control", "case"))

```

```{r}
prs_scores <- prs_scores %>%
  dplyr::mutate(ID = as.character(ID))

pheno <- pheno %>%
  dplyr::mutate(ID = as.character(ID))

df <- left_join(prs_scores, pheno, by = "ID") %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(T1GRS_ALL), !is.na(t1d))

dim(df)
colnames(df)
```

# **Visual representation of T1GRS across cases and control** 


```{r}
# Prepare medians
medians <- df %>%
  group_by(t1d) %>%
  summarise(median_val = median(T1GRS_ALL, na.rm = TRUE))

# Plot with ggplot2
ggplot(df, aes(x = factor(t1d), y = T1GRS_ALL, fill = factor(t1d))) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_text(data = medians, aes(x = factor(t1d), y = median_val, label = round(median_val, 3)),
            vjust = -0.5, color = "black", size = 3.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("lightblue", "lightcoral")) +
  labs(title = "T1GRS_tedmp by T1D Case/Control",
       x = "T1D Status",
       y = "T1GRS_ALL Score") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5),
        legend.position = "none")


```

```{r}

ggplot(df, aes(x = T1GRS_ALL, fill = t1d)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(title = "Density of T1GRS_tedmp by T1D group",
       x = "T1GRS_ALL Score", y = "Density") +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(df, aes(x = T1GRS_ALL, fill = t1d)) +
  geom_histogram(alpha = 0.6, bins = 20, position = "identity") +
  labs(title = "Histogram of T1GRS_tedmp Scores by T1D group",
       x = "T1GRS_ALL Score", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(df, aes(x = T1GRS_ALL, fill = t1d)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density)), alpha = 0.6, bins = 20, position = "identity") +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.4) +
  labs(title = "Histogram + Density of T1GRS_tedmp by T1D",
       x = "T1GRS_ALL Score", y = "Density") +
  theme_minimal()


```
# **Correlation**

```{r}

head(grs2)
head(GRS2x_imputed)
grs2$ID <- as.character(grs2$ID)

```


```{r}


GRS2x_imputed$ID <- sub(".*_", "", GRS2x_imputed$IID)

grs2x<- left_join(GRS2x_imputed, pheno, by = "ID")
grs2x <- grs2x %>%
   dplyr::filter(!is.na(t1dgrs2.luckett25_total), !is.na(t1d))
dim(grs2x)         # Check dimensions
colnames(grs2x)    # See available columns


```
 

```{r}

# Create correlation-ready dataframe with consistent names
corr_df <- df %>%
  select(ID, TIGRS = T1GRS_ALL) %>%
  left_join(grs2x %>% select(ID, GRS2x = t1dgrs2.luckett25_total), by = "ID") %>%
  left_join(grs2 %>% select(ID, AA_PRS, GRS2 = GRS2_1000G), by = "ID") %>%
  dplyr::filter(complete.cases(.))

# Reorder columns in desired order
corr_order <- c("AA_PRS", "GRS2", "GRS2x", "TIGRS")
cor_matrix <- cor(corr_df %>% select(all_of(corr_order)))

# Plot
ggcorrplot(cor_matrix, 
           method = "circle", 
           type = "lower", 
           lab = TRUE, 
           title = "Correlation among GRS2 Scores",
           colors = c("red", "white", "blue"),
           lab_size = 4,
           show.diag = TRUE)
  

```


```{r}


# Reorder columns in desired order
corr_order <- c("AA_PRS", "GRS2", "GRS2x", "TIGRS")

# Plot pairwise correlations and scatter plots
ggpairs(corr_df %>% select(all_of(corr_order)),
        title = "Pairwise Correlations and Scatter Plots for different Scores in TEDDY_matprot")

```
